title: Social media corpus document
description: One line of corpus.jsonl. Every platform uses these same fields; fields a platform lacks are empty strings, empty lists, or null.

platform.description: Source platform, or other for any other site yt-dlp supports (see site).

site.description: Website the document came from, such as youtube.com or rumble.com. Use this to tell 'other' sites apart.

post_id.description: Platform id of the post this document belongs to.

parent_id.description: For comments, the doc_id being replied to. Empty for posts.

url.description: Link to the document. Empty when pseudonymized.

author.description: Account name, or a pseudonym such as u_3f9a1c02de.

author_id.description: Platform account id, or the pseudonym.

created_at.description: Posting time, ISO 8601 UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Empty if unknown.

title.description: Title (YouTube, Reddit, and other video sites).

text.description: What the author typed. Never AI-generated.

caption_transcript.description: Speech transcript from platform captions (YouTube timedtext, TikTok captions).

caption_source.description: manual, auto, none, or empty for comments.

llm_transcript.description: Speech transcript from the model, one line per speaker turn, prefixed with the speaker label (A:, B:, ?:).

on_screen_text.description: Text shown in the video or images, from the model, separated by ' | '.

visual_description.description: Description of the visuals, from the model.

audio_description.description: Music and non-speech audio, from the model.

speakers.description: Distinct voices the model heard, labeled A, B, C in order of first speech.

language.description: Language code from the platform, or from the model if the platform gave none.

like_count.description: Likes (Reddit: net score) at collection time.

reply_count.description: Replies or comments at collection time.

share_count.description: Shares, reposts, or quotes at collection time.

ai_generated.description: True when any model-produced field (extraction or translation) has content.

llm_model.description: OpenRouter model that produced the model fields.

llm_error.description: Why model extraction or translation was skipped or failed.

translation_language.description: Target language of the translated_* fields. Empty when translation was off.

translated_llm_transcript.description: Model translation of llm_transcript, keeping speaker labels.

source_input.description: Exactly what was pasted to collect this document.

segments.description: Time-stamped transcript pieces for this document (posts only).

speaker.description: Speaker label for model segments (A, B, ?); empty for captions.
